Kansas Corporation Commission
                                 Commission Meeting
                            November 17, 2026 @ 10:00 am
                  KCC Offices, 1500 SW Arrowhead Rd., Topeka, Kansas

                                         MINUTES

The Commission convened the regularly scheduled open meeting of the Commission at 10:03 am
on November 17, 2026, at the Kansas Corporation Commission, 1500 SW Arrowhead Road,
Topeka, Kansas.

Present: Commissioner Keen, Commissioner Kuether, and Assistant General Counsel Aaron
Bailey. Chairperson French was absent. The following were considered by the Commission:
     1.   Consent Agenda: Commissioner Kuether moved for approval of the Items on the
          Consent Agenda dated November 17, 2026. The Consent Agenda contains pages one
          through seven and is attached to the Minutes. Commissioner Keen seconded the
          motion.
          The motion was approved.
     2.   Noticed Items:
           A. Docket No. 27-EKCE-0193-COM
               In the Matter of the Complaint Against Evergy Kansas Central by Latisah
               Cristine Michaux
               O-005938 - Order on Prima Facie Determination
               Commissioner Kuether moved to approve the Order. Commissioner Keen
               seconded the motion.
               The order was approved.

           B. Docket No. 25-EKME-189-COM
              In the Matter of the Complaint Against Evergy by Wayne C. Young.
               O-005936 - Order Denying Complaint
               Commissioner Kuether moved to approve the Order. Commissioner Keen
               seconded the motion.
               The order was approved.

           C. Docket No. 27-EKME-0186-COM
              In the Matter of the Complaint Against Evergy Kansas Metro by Monica
              Martinez
               O-005937 - Order Making Prima Facie Determination



                                         Page 1 of 2
                        Commissioner Kuether moved to approve the Order. Commissioner Keen
                       seconded the motion.
                       The order was approved.

    There being no further matters before the Commission, Commissioner Kuether moved for
    adjournment of the Commission meeting. Commissioner Keen seconded the motion. The
    Commission adjourned the November 17, 2026, Commission Meeting at 10:10 am.




                                                               Absent
                                                               Andrew J. French, Chair




                                                               Dwight D. Keen, Commissioner




Attest:


          Jesse R. Becker, Executive Director                  Annie Kuether, Commissioner




                                                 Page 2 of 2

                                                                                      Consent Agenda

NOTICE TO THE PUBLIC: There will be no separate discussion of Consent Agenda items as they are
considered to be routine by the Kansas Corporation Commission. Unless removed from the website's Consent
Agenda, the orders appearing on the Consent Agenda will become the Order of the full Commission at the
Commission’s regularly scheduled Business Meeting. If Commission staff or a Commissioner requests an item
be removed from the Consent Agenda, the affected item may be considered separately or placed on the earliest
possible Business Meeting agenda for discussion.
